profile.reading:
This OpenStreetMap record at 19 College Avenue in Rexburg, Idaho, tagged as a telecom data center, is named VentureData. Venture Data, LLC is a real and active company, a telephone survey and market research firm headquartered in Orem, Utah, that has conducted political polling and public opinion research since 1994 for clients including NBC and the Wall Street Journal. Its public website describes computer aided telephone interviewing operations staffed by hundreds of trained interviewers, run from call center locations including one near Brigham Young University Idaho in Rexburg, a college town that has long supported a local call center industry drawing on student and local labor.

A calling center built around banks of interviewer workstations and telephone systems is a fundamentally different kind of facility from a data center built around server racks, cooling, and standby power for outside colocation customers. Nothing in Venture Data's public materials describes this Rexburg address as hosting server infrastructure for other companies, and the building most plausibly houses office space and interviewer stations rather than a data center in the sense this registry otherwise tracks. This entry is published without data center specifications because the underlying business, while real, does not appear to operate a colocation or hosting facility at this address.

Independent verification of its current ownership, business model, and operational detail could not be completed.
